def factor_volatility_attenuated_price_volume_corr(df):
    """20-day price-volume correlation attenuated under short-term volatility stress."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]

    close_ret = close.pct_change()
    vol_ret = volume.replace(0, np.nan).pct_change()
    corr = close_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(vol_ret)
    corr = corr.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    _, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(close, open_)
    short_vol = intraday_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=20).std().shift(1)
    long_vol = intraday_ret.rolling(120, min_periods=30).std().shift(1)
    vol_stress = short_vol / long_vol.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_stress = vol_stress.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    attenuation = np.exp(-0.3 * vol_stress.clip(0.0, 5.0))
    factor = corr * attenuation
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volatility_attenuated_price_volume_corr"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volatility_attenuated_price_volume_corr"]
